crossRefs.note: So Michal let David down through the window. He went away, fled, and escaped.

“Their feet are swift to shed blood.
You will destroy those who speak lies. Yahweh abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.
Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!
Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…

translations.web: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!
translations.bsb: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
translations.kjv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.
translations.asv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: Awake thou to help me, and behold.
